name: Decision

title: "[DISCUSS]: "
labels: []
type: Task
---

<!--
Someone who missed the meeting must be able to understand what was at stake and why the outcome was chosen.
Every section above "Decision" is filled when the issue is opened. "Decision" stays empty until the decision is taken.
-->

## Question

<!-- One closed question that has an answer, e.g. "Do we deploy one URL per brand, or one shared URL?" -->

## Context

<!-- What exists today, what triggered the question, with links to code, issues or documents. -->

## Why now

<!-- What waits on this decision and what happens if it is not taken. The deadline goes in the Target date field. -->

## Constraints

<!-- Fixed facts any option must respect: technical, contractual, brand, budget, timing. "None" if nothing. -->

## Options

<!-- At least two, including "keep things as they are" when it is a real option. -->

| Option | Description | Pros | Cons | Effort |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | | | | |
| B | | | | |

## Decision criteria

<!-- What the choice is judged on, most important first: user impact, cost, risk, time to deliver, reversibility. -->

## Recommendation

<!-- Optional. The reporter's preferred option and why — clearly a proposal, not the decision. -->

## People

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Decides** | <!-- one person --> |
| **Consulted** | <!-- who must give input before the decision; external parties also go in the External party field --> |
| **Informed** | <!-- who needs to know the outcome --> |

## Decision

<!-- Filled when decided. The issue is not closed while these fields are empty. -->

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Outcome** | |
| **Decided by** | |
| **Date** | |
| **Rationale** | |
| **Options discarded and why** | |

<!-- Issues the decision creates, linked as sub-issues of this one. -->
